SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_receipts,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE fsl.sale_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= rfc.period_end_date
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web/pseudo locations
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN ds.store_id >= 900 THEN 'Web'
    ELSE ds.format 
  END AS format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_receipts,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE fsl.sale_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= rfc.period_end_date
GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN ds.store_id >= 900 THEN 'Web'
    ELSE ds.format 
  END
ORDER BY format

-- Check for any records with null net_amount or missing store_key
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as total_receipts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_net_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_store_key
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE fsl.sale_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= rfc.period_end_date

-- Final query: ATV by store format for period 4 FY2026/27
SELECT 
  ds.format AS store_format,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS average_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE fsl.sale_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= rfc.period_end_date
  AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.format
